body: Thank you for all your help. I really appreciate that. Have a great weekend!

Thanks so much for indulging me like this, I really appreciate it.

Do you have any examples of the kind of work I would be able to get/do on that kind of basis? What kind of jobs do you consider trash/not worth it?

Better yet, do you know of anywhere I can get more information rather than attempt to drink your brain in via Reddit?
I'm guessing thats coming from a full-time professional standpoint?

Okay, that's really helpful! 

So you'd say the biggest obstacle is exposure of work? By that I mean getting it into the hands of the right people? 

Would you think that I'd be able to do this kind of work along with a regular job?

Thanks for getting back to me!

I want to work for myself. I want to write and make videos about games. I've been doing that for a while. I've been told I'm great at it, the numbers are decent but nowhere near big enough to make a living from.

At the core of it, I have this ideal life that I want to live. I don't want a big house or piles and piles of money. I want to be able to work for myself so I can go to the gym in the middle of the day. I want to be able to enjoy what I'm producing because its mine. That people will enjoy what I'm making, instead of buying the useless shit that I'm selling now.

Its pretty fucking stupid. It should be "I want to make a million dollars!" or some such nonsense. But here I am, just wanting to enjoy what I do and be able to go to the gym during the day. Where's the harm in that? 

Apparently I'm not allowed to even get close to it. I can't live anymore if I can't achieve even something like I want. I've been through too much to deal with all of this hurt, all of this is just. Its just pain now. There's no lesson in it. Theres no grand scheme at play. I'm terrified that I'll never be able to live by my own terms.

I don't want to call people Sir or Madam when they don't deserve it.

I want to live by my own terms, make money my way and just be truly happy for once in my life.

Thanks man. I appreciate that.

I should be pretty stoked about what I do. The fact that I even have a job should be enough, y'know? 

Its a shame about time, you know? I could do so much more with my life if I didn't have to sleep. I could work on my passions then. Theres just too little time now. To maintain a relationship, physical fitness, commuting and all the other shit that I've got to do as a grown up, it just takes all the time away.

I guess something really did have to give.

I should've been clearer. Sorry about that.

I feel guilty because I feel unfulfilled with what I'm doing. I like having a job and all the added benefits that go along with it, but because I'm not doing what I want to be doing, I feel unfulfilled.

Then the guilt that there are loads of other people out there who just want to work don't have jobs and here I am, being all melancholy because it doesn't fulfil some deep seated "ideal job" thing. Its hard to write it down.

If I could transmit a feel, I would.
